description: DEMO portfolio (synthetic, shared, read-only). Read the portfolio's risk picture in selectable pieces instead of the whole context. include (default ['metrics']) ⊆ metrics, drawdown, correlations, diversification, benchmarks, fxAttribution, fingerprint. metrics = volatility, Sharpe, Sortino, max and current drawdown, best and worst day, plus the note on what the per-holding risk figures mean. drawdown = the max drawdown's peak, trough, recovery and length, and the current one. correlations = the strongest pairs, strongest absolute correlation first, with the effective number of independent bets. diversification = the 0-100 score, its grade, the sub-scores and the card's own takeaways. benchmarks = one row per selected benchmark with its own return and the portfolio's beta and correlation to it. fxAttribution = how much of the return came from the currencies rather than from the assets. fingerprint = the Portfolio Fingerprint card: six axes (value, growth, past, health, income, diversification) scored 0-6 by fixed pass/fail checks, each with its measured value, threshold and coverage, plus the card's one-line verdict. range (all | 1y, default all) applies to the ratio metrics only — 1y gives the trailing-year volatility, Sharpe and Sortino plus the rolling 12-month envelope, while drawdowns, correlations and diversification are always whole-history. UNITS: volatility, maxDrawdown, currentDrawdown, correlation and the daily returns bestDay.ret and worstDay.ret are FRACTIONS (0.18 = 18%); a field ending in Pct is a percent. Statistics of the user's own history; never investment advice.
